target_problem: irreducible nonmonotone NC0_3-Avoid kernels after V97 peeling
conditional_implication: A positive-surplus component whose essential local gates are unate and whose incidence directions satisfy d(e,v)=r_v XOR q_e is switch-equivalent to a monotone NC0_3 component. Kuntewar-Sarma then gives deterministic polynomial-time avoidance. Separately, parity labels make an explicit loose-X submap surjective, so loose-X support alone cannot certify avoidance for arbitrary labels.
frontier_reason: The balanced-unate subclass is polynomial and strictly contains raw monotone labels on irreducible large kernels, but unrestricted non-unate labels remain open and no published lower-bound-transfer threshold is crossed.

bridge_lemmas.name: essential unate direction is uniquely defined per incidence
switching-balance is an XOR-consistency problem on the incidence graph and is recognizable in linear time
a consistent input/output switching makes every local gate monotone
input/output switching preserves range membership up to a codomain XOR
Kuntewar-Sarma monotone NC0_3 m>n algorithm transfers to every balanced-unate positive-surplus component
there is an exact-stretch connected nonmonotone essential-ternary family with V97 lambda=N that is balanced-unate
an explicit parity-labeled loose X is surjective for every length in the family
the loose-X obstruction embeds in an exact-stretch V97-irreducible parity host
every unate irreducible kernel is switching-balanced
all non-unate loose-X labels admit a polynomial forbidden-coloring constructor

closed_route: support-only claim that loose-X existence forces a missing edge coloring for arbitrary ternary labels
surviving_route: classify the incidence-sign obstruction for unate labels beyond balance, then attack genuinely non-unate ternary NPN classes by transfer automata or larger Turan substructures
current_gap: Large V97 kernels may contain non-unate gates or unate direction cycles with nonzero XOR. Those instances cannot be globally switched to the published monotone class by the V98 criterion.
stop_rule: Do not spend V99 enlarging finite truth-table censuses. Promote only a symbolic classification/constructor for an unbalanced-unate or genuinely non-unate family, or an asymptotic obstruction that closes such a class.
